clause_title: Review of requirements for products and services
semantic_category_source: default (clause not present in any severity-ceiling list; see docs/eei-blueprint-crosswalk.md gap #4)

requirements.subject: organization
requirements.obligation: ensure it has the ability to meet requirements and conduct a review covering customer-defined requirements, requirements not defined by the customer but necessary for intended use, organization-specified requirements, statutory and regulatory requirements, and differing contract or order requirements; resolve any differing requirements; and confirm customer requirements when not documented by the customer
requirements.object: before committing to supply products and services to a customer
requirements.condition: before committing to supply products and services to a customer
